summary: Blue Light Phase 5 — Customer Portal Certificates, FRONTEND ONLY. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com (platform /login, token in localStorage) and exercised the portal Certificates tab end-to-end on the LiteDashboardPage (/pulse). All 5 requested features PASS: (1) 'Certificates' nav item appears (data-testid lite-tab-certificates) after the /api/customer/certificates/summary call resolves; (2) tab content renders (customer-certificates-tab) with 2 cards — 'Appledore Fire Station' and 'Bruton Fire Station', both showing 'CTR-BLFRS1 · Serviced Aug 28, 2026' + 'Next due Feb 26, 2027'; (3) cert-next-due badge shows 'NEXT SERVICE DUE / Feb 26, 2027'; (4) typing 'Bruton' in cert-search filters to exactly 1 card and clearing restores 2; (5) cert-download-<id> downloads a real PDF (Example-Fire-Rescue-Service_Appledore-Fire-Station_Service-and-Calibration_2026-08-28.pdf, 121,731 bytes, %PDF header). Also verified: deep link /pulse?tab=certificates opens the tab directly, no-match search shows certs-empty, contract filter correctly hidden with a single contract, mobile 390x844 layout stacks cleanly, zero console errors and zero error elements on the page.

issues: No-match search shows the generic first-run copy: 'No certificates found yet. They appear here once a station service is completed.' — misleading when the user has certificates but the search simply matched nothing. Suggest a distinct 'No certificates match "<term>"' message when search/contract filters are active.

The 'Next service due' badge (cert-next-due) disappears while a search filter is active (next_service_due is derived from the filtered response). The soonest-due date is org-level information and arguably should stay pinned regardless of the filter.
Download failure path uses a native window.alert() instead of an in-UI error/toast (CustomerCertificatesTab.js line 36) — inconsistent with the rest of the portal.
Mobile (390px): PDF button measures 76x36px, slightly under the 44px recommended touch-target height. Cosmetic.

action_items: OPTIONAL/INFO — routing expectation mismatch in the review note: the Certificates tab exists ONLY in LiteDashboardPage (/pulse). pages/Dashboard/DashboardTabs.js and pages/DashboardPage.js contain no 'certificates' entry, so an account_type='full' user landing on /dashboard (Operations) will NOT see it. owner@isodemo.com also has is_service_desk=true, so login redirects to /service-desk; the tester had to navigate to /pulse. Real Lite/pulse_pro customers land on /pulse directly (DashboardRoute redirects them), so the customer-facing behaviour is correct — but the claim 'shows in the dashboard nav right after login' is not true for this operator/service-desk account.
MINOR — differentiate the empty state for 'no search match' vs 'no certificates yet'.
MINOR — keep the cert-next-due badge visible when search/contract filters are applied, or label it as filter-scoped.
MINOR — replace the window.alert() download-failure path with an inline error/toast.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerCertificatesTab.js: axios .catch() swallows the failure and renders the empty state — a 401/500 is indistinguishable from 'no certificates'. Add an error state so a broken token/API surfaces to the user instead of a false 'no certificates yet'.

CustomerCertificatesTab.js load(): 250ms debounce fires on mount too, adding a small blank/spinner delay; also the request is not aborted on re-type, so a slow earlier response can overwrite a newer one (no request-sequence guard).
LiteDashboardPage.js is ~1,313 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; the tab registry/nav config should be extracted.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); summary/list endpoints spot-checked via curl and returned correct data

seed_data_creation: None created. Existing Blue Light seed (Example Fire & Rescue, contract CTR-BLFRS1, 2 sent certificates) left untouched as instructed.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! at /login (token in localStorage 'token'). NOTE: /api/auth/login is IP rate-limited to 5 attempts / 5 min — the run hit HTTP 429 twice. Clear it with: cd /app/backend && python tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py (deletes db.rate_buckets docs with _id starting 'login').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do NOT test the Certificates tab on /dashboard — for owner@isodemo.com (account_type full, is_service_desk) login redirects to /service-desk and /dashboard renders the Operations DashboardPage which has no certificates tab. Navigate to /pulse (LiteDashboardPage) or deep link /pulse?tab=certificates, which works. Allow ~9-10s after navigating for the summary fetch to resolve before the nav item appears. cert-search is debounced 250ms + network, so wait ~2.5s after fill before counting cards. Login rate limit: use /app/backend/tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py between runs.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found in Phase 5. The only friction was a test-environment login rate limit (429 from utils/security.rate_limit_login: 5 attempts / 5 min per IP) plus the review note's incorrect assumption that the Certificates tab is present in DashboardTabs.js — it is only wired into LiteDashboardPage.js (nav item id 'certificates' + TabsContent data-testid 'certificates-content', both gated on hasCertificates from /api/customer/certificates/summary).
